data.cultural_impact: The name Garibaldo carries a rich heritage, originating from medieval Italy. It represents the bravery and valor of a soldier in the Christian army. The name signifies a fearless warrior, a defender of faith, and someone who was not afraid to face challenges.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Garibaldo holds deep spiritual significance, reminding us of the faith and sacrifice of Saint Garibaldo. He is remembered as a soldier of Christ, who put his life on the line to protect the church and spread the Gospel. The name encourages us to live our lives with courage, integrity, and a steadfast commitment to our faith. It invites us to be bold in our convictions, unwavering in our belief, and steadfast in our service to God.

historical_references.reference: Born in 1542 in northern Italy, Garibaldo I de' Medici was a condottiero who fought for various Italian city-states.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Garibaldo continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Garibaldo in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Garibaldo, which means "Brave as a spear". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Garibaldo: Brave and dedicated in the service of God. A warrior in the spirit, bearing the cross in times of adversity.
